claim_boundary: C010 adds eight inherited proof-compression descendants. None is proved, independently reproduced, or certified novel.

hypotheses.title: Monomial-Basis Congruence Transport Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: For every n and k, every coordinate permutation together with any subset of coordinate complementations x_i -> 1-x_i induces an invertible integer matrix T on the squarefree monomial basis of degree at most k, with entries in {-1,0,1}, such that z_k(phi(x)) = T^T z_k(x). Consequently every rational Gram certificate Q is transported by the congruence Q -> T Q T^T without increasing polynomial degree, and coefficient bit length grows by at most a polynomial in the basis dimension and input bit length.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This supplies the explicit algebraic core missing from H075 and removes coordinate permutations and complementations from the list of possible causes of theta-rank collapse.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: turn H075's symmetry intuition into a checkable monomial-basis and Gram-matrix transport statement.
hypotheses.next_gate: Complete the universal coefficient bound in the written proof and obtain independent review of the exact matrix orientation and quotient-ring conventions.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H084 replaces H075's global theta-rank statement by an explicit integer change-of-basis identity whose inverse, degree bound, and Gram congruence can be checked mechanically.
falsification_conditions: A signed coordinate permutation for which the degree-at-most-k squarefree basis is not mapped into itself.
A transported rational Gram certificate whose required coefficient bit length grows superpolynomially in the stated parameters.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The lemma covers only coordinate permutations and complementations. It does not cover XOR substitution, existential projection, or arbitrary auxiliary-variable extensions.

hypotheses.title: Bounded-Depth Functional Extension Pullback Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: Fix constants s and d. Let an exact Boolean extension introduce auxiliary variables by an acyclic circuit of depth at most d, fan-in at most s, and multilinear defining polynomials with polynomial-bit coefficients. Every degree-2k Sum-of-Squares or theta certificate over the extension ring pulls back by functional substitution to a certificate over the original variables of degree at most 2k*s^d and polynomial total bit length for fixed s,d.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This proves the certificate-substitution core of H077 for functional bounded-depth extensions and rules out a constant-rank collapse caused solely by such definitions.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: isolate the functional-substitution theorem needed before H077 can become a theta-rank preservation result.
hypotheses.next_gate: Formalize substitution in the quotient ring, charge sharing and coefficient growth, and prove that all extension axioms vanish after pullback.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H085 replaces H077's full rank comparison by one explicit certificate pullback theorem with a quantitative degree bound.
falsification_conditions: A bounded-depth functional extension whose valid bounded-degree certificate has no pulled-back certificate within degree 2k*s^d.
A constant-depth family for which coefficient or monomial growth is superpolynomial despite fixed fan-in and polynomial-bit definitions.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The conjecture excludes nonfunctional existential fibers and unbounded dependency depth; those remain possible sources of projection collapse.

hypotheses.title: Projection-Fiber Necessity Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: Any family witnessing the theta-rank collapse required by H076 must use at least one resource not covered by H085: nonfunctional extension fibers, unbounded extension depth, superpolynomial coefficient growth, or superpolynomial expanded representation size.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The search for counterexamples to H071 is reduced to four explicit escape resources, and bounded-depth functional extensions cease to be a plausible hidden loophole.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: convert the pullback theorem sought in H085 into a structural classification of every possible H076 collapse.
hypotheses.next_gate: Prove the contrapositive from H085 plus exact projection semantics, then test whether known extension constructions fall into one of the four escape classes.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H086 turns the competing H076/H077 pair into a resource dichotomy rather than leaving projection collapse as an undifferentiated possibility.
falsification_conditions: A bounded-depth functional exact extension with polynomial coefficients and polynomial expanded size that collapses unbounded theta rank to a constant.
A fifth collapse resource outside the stated disjunction.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The statement is conditional on the exact pullback accounting of H085 and is not itself a lower bound for arbitrary extensions.

hypotheses.title: Canonical Level-One Theta-Twin Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist explicit polynomial-time constructible satisfiable and unsatisfiable CNF families whose exactly variable-canonicalized clause-literal conflict graphs have equal level-one theta optimum and admit rational degree-two moment solutions agreeing under a fixed coordinate bijection on every registered canonical moment.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The first theta level, even after exact variable renaming and fixed answer-independent profiling, cannot decide SAT universally on the standard conflict-graph encoding.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_TARGET: reduce H078 to one exact level, one encoding, and one finite rational witness interface that can be searched and independently checked.
hypotheses.next_gate: Implement an external-solver artifact format for rational moment witnesses, enumerate small CNFs, and require exact certificate replay before claiming a finite twin.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H087 fixes k=1, exact variable canonicalization, rational witnesses, and the standard conflict graph, making H078's first unresolved case computationally concrete.
falsification_conditions: A theorem that the registered level-one moment interface always separates SAT from UNSAT on the canonical conflict graph.
Exhaustive coverage of a formally bounded class showing no twin, together with a proof that the class contains every candidate of the stated size.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: No twin is claimed to have been found. Exact-alpha diagnostics are excluded from the canonical profile and cannot be used as an observable.

hypotheses.title: Local Gadget Pseudoexpectation Transport Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every fixed-radius uniform clause-gadget compiler in the class targeted by H079 and every fixed pseudoexpectation degree 2k, a degree-2k pseudoexpectation for the source CSP can be transported to a degree-O(k) pseudoexpectation for the compiled graph SDP with only constant-factor loss in local consistency parameters.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Known or newly constructed pseudoexpectations could be pushed through all permitted local graph gadgets, strengthening H079 from one generic reduction to a whole compiler class.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: provide the missing witness-transfer theorem behind the local theta barrier H079.
hypotheses.next_gate: Define the gadget transduction category, prove transport for one clause gadget, and compose it while charging overlap between neighboring gadgets.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H088 replaces H079's qualitative gadget-preservation hope by a precise pseudoexpectation transport obligation.
falsification_conditions: A fixed-radius gadget whose compiled constraints destroy every bounded-degree pseudoexpectation despite preserving satisfiability.
Degree blow-up depending on global instance size rather than k and gadget radius.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The conjecture concerns fixed-radius uniform gadgets only and does not cover global spectral or adaptive compilation.

hypotheses.title: Exact Rational Gram-Factor Verification Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: Given rational matrices and vectors encoded in binary, a certificate containing exact rational Gram factors for every claimed positive-semidefinite matrix, exact linear-constraint residuals, and a rational objective margin can be verified deterministically in time polynomial in matrix dimensions and total input bit length.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The verification half of H081 becomes a concrete exact-arithmetic component; numerical optimization remains separate from certificate checking.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: replace vague exact SDP verification by an explicit rational factor-and-residual certificate language.
hypotheses.next_gate: Extend the self-tested matrix checker to the full fixed theta SDP constraint schema and obtain an independently generated certificate artifact.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H089 narrows the conditioned certificate route to a purely syntactic verifier whose complexity depends only on the supplied rational artifact.
falsification_conditions: A valid certificate in the stated format whose exact verification requires superpolynomial arithmetic operations in its encoded size.
A claimed PSD matrix accepted despite failing the supplied exact Gram identity.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The lemma does not assert that short rational Gram factors always exist or that an SDP solver can find them efficiently.

hypotheses.title: Restriction-Closed Mixed-Family Constructor Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is an explicit polynomial-time generator combining an expander-based XOR core with deterministic non-affine gadgets such that every restriction leaving n^delta live variables preserves a degree n^c pseudoexpectation after exhaustive Gaussian elimination, unless the residual representation becomes superpolynomial.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This supplies the explicit restriction-robust family demanded by H083 and creates a common target for H062, H064, H088, and parity-aware proof lower bounds.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_TARGET: turn H083's abstract target into one generator with a reproducible restriction and pseudoexpectation contract.
hypotheses.next_gate: Specify the XOR core, the nonlinear gadget, the restriction distribution, and one local pseudoexpectation composition lemma.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H090 replaces the existential mixed family of H083 by a single generator architecture and a concrete pseudoexpectation preservation contract.
falsification_conditions: A restriction strategy leaving n^delta variables that collapses the generated family to bounded-degree solvability with polynomial size.
Failure of local pseudoexpectation composition on the chosen nonlinear gadget.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: No generator has yet been completed and no lower bound is claimed.

hypotheses.title: Bounded-Degree Theta-to-Parity-Proof Transfer Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For the mixed family generated by H090, every polynomial-size parity-aware refutation in a fixed bounded-degree algebraic Res(XOR)-style fragment can be translated with polynomial overhead into a bounded-degree SoS or theta certificate on the affine residual ideal after the functional pullbacks permitted by H085.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: A theta/SoS degree lower bound for H090 would transfer to a named parity-aware proof fragment, connecting the theta branch to H064 and the salvage solver H063.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_PROOF_COMPLEXITY_ROUTE: create a measure-preserving bridge from the residual theta lower bound to a precise parity proof system.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fix the proof syntax and degree measure, translate one inference rule at a time, and identify any rule that escapes the theta/SoS encoding.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H091 adds the missing proof-system simulation needed before H083-style geometric hardness can say anything about parity-aware refutations.
falsification_conditions: A bounded-degree parity inference with no polynomial-size theta/SoS simulation under the fixed encoding.
A short refutation of H090 whose translated certificate necessarily has superpolynomial degree or bit length.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The conjecture concerns one explicitly bounded algebraic fragment, not unrestricted dag-like Res(XOR).
